case_name: Anita Devi & Ors vs State Of Bihar Thr Its Local Resident

parties.respondent_defendant: State Of Bihar Thr Its Local Resident Commissioner & Ors. (husband's estate, respondents)

facts_of_case: Appellants are wife and children of deceased employee Sh.Girdhari Rai. He was married to Smt. Hira Devi and had four children. Appellants claim monetary benefits arising due to his death.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party claiming a share to prove their entitlement.
legal_principles.held: Though none has appeared for respondents No.6 to 10, namely, the first wife and her children, we have perused the counter affidavit filed by them before the learned Single Judge.
cited_cases: Rameshwari Devi vs. State of Bihar & Ors., (2000) 2 SCC 431
Vidhyadhari & Ors. vs. Sukhrana Bai & Ors., (2008) 2 SCC 238

legal_principles.principle: A disputed question of fact cannot be decided in a writ petition.
legal_principles.held: The impugned order also notes that the first wife and children were the nominees in the pension and group insurance account and as to whether this was validly done or not was a disputed question of fact that cannot be decided in a writ petition.

outcome.final_order: Delay in filing appeal condoned; order dated 23.12.2009 passed by Resident Commissioner, Bihar Bhawan, New Delhi, set aside.

use_for_drafting: seeking monetary benefits for a deceased employee
